help: In the query editor, type an abbreviation and press Tab to expand it; Tab and Shift+Tab move from one field to the next. Abbreviations also show up in autocomplete. Each engine has its own built-in set (sel, selc, ins, upd, del, cte, ij, lj, crt…) in its own syntax.
empty: You haven't added any snippets yet. One of yours with the same abbreviation as a built-in one replaces it.
badAbbr: The abbreviation can only contain letters, numbers and underscores.
duplicated: Another snippet has the same abbreviation for the same engines; the first one is used.
builtInHelp: Fields are written ${1:text}: the number sets the order and the text is the initial value. ${} marks where the cursor ends up.
